description: This file defines a Perl module 'Git::SVN::Prompt' that provides authentication callback functions for SVN operations integrated with Git. It includes methods for handling user credentials, SSL server trust, client certificates, and username prompts, primarily intended for use within the 'git svn' command-line tool.

methods.name: simple
methods.description: Handles simple authentication by setting username and retrieving password from user input.

methods.name: ssl_server_trust
methods.description: Prompts and handles validation for SSL server certificates, including failures like hostname mismatch or expiration.

methods.name: ssl_client_cert
methods.description: Prompts for a client SSL certificate filename and sets it for authentication.

methods.name: ssl_client_cert_pw
methods.description: Prompts for a password for the SSL client certificate.

methods.name: username
methods.description: Prompts for or uses a predefined username for authentication.

methods.name: _read_password
methods.description: Reads a password securely from user input.
